## Interactive gapminder

1.  Design the following [shiny app](https://exptime.shinyapps.io/gapminder/) using gapminder dataset
2.  Create an account on [Shinyapps.io](https://www.shinyapps.io/) and [deploy](https://docs.rstudio.com/shinyapps.io/getting-started.html#installation) your app there


## Our solution

Prima di tutto vedo come è fattoil dataset.

```{r}
library(gapminder)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(shiny)

df = gapminder

df
```

Prima di tutto creo la ui:

```{r}
ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Shiny Gapminder"),
  
  sidebarLayout(
    
    sidebarPanel(
  
      # Lo slider
      sliderInput(
        inputId = "yr",
        label = "Year",
        min = min(df$year),
        max = max(df$year),
        value = min(df$year),
        step = 5
      ),
      
      selectInput(
        inputId = "cont",
        label = "Continent",
        choices = c(
          "Africa" = "Africa",
          "Americas" = "Americas",
          "Asia" = "Asia",
          "Europa" = "Europe",
          "Oceania" = "Oceania",
          "All" = "All"
        ),
        selected = "All"
      ),
      
      radioButtons(
        inputId = "xas",
        label = "X",
        choices = c(
          "Life Expentacy" = "lifeExp",
          "Population" = "pop",
          "GDP per capita" = "gdpPercap"
        ),
        selected = "lifeExp"
      ),
      
      radioButtons(
        inputId = "yas",
        label = "Y",
        choices = c(
          "Life Expentacy" = "lifeExp",
          "Population" = "pop",
          "GDP per capita" = "gdpPercap"
        ),
        selected = "gdpPercap"
      ),
    ),
    
    mainPanel(
      plotOutput("scatter"),
    )
    
  )
)
```

Poi creo la parte del server:

```{r}
server <- function(input, output) {
  
  # Scatterplot
  output$scatter <- renderPlot({

    #year filter
    if( input$cont == "All"){
      df = df |>
        filter(year == input$yr)
    } else {
      df = df |>
        filter(year == input$yr, continent == input$cont)
    }

    df |>
      ggplot(aes(x = .data[[input$xas]], y = .data[[input$yas]], size = pop, colour = country)) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
      scale_color_manual(values = country_colors) +
      scale_size(range = c(2, 20)) +
      scale_x_log10() +
      scale_y_log10() +
      theme_minimal()

  })
}
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```

Suggerimenti della ai: 
- .data[[input$xas]] usando aes, invece di usare aes_string che è deprecato
